steps.content: The three of you squeeze into the tiny phone booth. You face the corner and try your best to wiggle in further.
steps.female_content: The three of you squeeze into the tiny phone booth, your breaths falling on each other, and the sound of your heartbeats clearly audible.

steps.content: The breaths, the heartbeats, and the howling outside intertwine to make you uneasy.
steps.female_content: Accompanied by the howling outside, it makes you uneasy.

steps.content: Eleven still seems overcome by emotion. She shrinks in the corner, burying her face between her knees and clutching her device.
The words of gratitude are still on the screen. She simply stares at them, and stares at them more.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't worry, as long as we solve this situation here and prevent it from affecting the real world...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The record store, the owner, and your job will all be fine.
Eleven nods, but in a matter of a second, the world in front of you suddenly turns pitch black.
The sounds in your ears, even the subtlest ones, become clearer and clearer.
None of you dare to speak. You all wait for this collapse to pass.
Ting-a-ling... ting-a-ling...
The phone suddenly rings in the booth, gripping everyone by the heart. And your hearts begin pounding again.
You fumble to pick up the receiver and bring it to your ear.

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: Standing by the window, you look out.

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: The passerby returns the gaze.

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: You're the ornament of his dream.

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: Do you like this poem? If you do... next time, I'll read you the rest.

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: Do you feel lucky? Take it as an honor~

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: Think of it as my encouragement for you. In this world... what kind of wonderful voice will you find for me?

steps.speaker: Familiar Female Voice
steps.content: Also... I'm eager to see how you will use... the voice you already have.
The darkness surges in, eventually submerging the tiny phone booth. This is when your consciousness goes out completely.
